title: Create a Value, Trust & Business Impact page for CEOs/CTOs/CISOs/investors
story: As a CEO, CTO, CISO, or investor evaluating DaemonCore, I want a clear, credible explanation of the business value and trust outcomes DaemonCore provides, so that I can understand why governance beneath orchestration matters and decide whether to adopt or invest.
description: Add a dedicated value/outcomes page (e.g. `/value` or `/why-it-matters`) that translates DaemonCore's technical guarantees into business outcomes (risk reduction, containment, accountability, auditability, compliance readiness, and vendor independence). Keep it executive-readable and technically honest. Link to Kernel/Walkthrough for proof and to Early Access for CTA.
acceptance_criteria: A new Value/Outcomes page exists and is linked from the homepage and FAQ.
The page is written for CEOs/CTOs/CISOs/investors (executive-readable, calm, precise).
It defines 3–5 value pillars and maps each to concrete DaemonCore V1 guarantees (no speculative claims).
It explicitly explains why orchestration alone is insufficient for trust and accountability.
It avoids marketing fluff/hype and does not duplicate Kernel/Walkthrough/FAQ content.
Claims are versioned where relevant (V1 vs V1.5) and do not imply V1.5 is already shipped.
UK spelling and consistent tone with the rest of the site.
